_comment: CAPABILITY suite: a Kafka stream publisher over messages whose SHAPE VARIES, and the dead-letter topic that takes the ones its schema refuses. The redpanda domain's create-data and modify-data run with --schema-changes: within each batch row j is sent as the model made it when j mod 4 is 0, with an extra xp_extra field when 1, without its last field when 2, and with its first field another JSON type when 3 (a number as its string, a string as a one-element list) -- and the trail in ${xp:dir}/ops.jsonl holds each row as sent. Functions in functions/caps_kafka_topics.py: kafka_varied (collection varied, kafka_topic_in_multi.yaml) reads departments and employees by the regex ^<prefix>\.(departments|employees)$ with typed schemas that require only each entity's first field, so an extra or a missing field validates -- the encoder starts a new frame for a message whose fields are not the frame's, and diagonal_relaxed folds them into one table, the missing values null -- while a retyped first field is refused and produced to <prefix>.dead; kafka_dead (collection dead, kafka_topic_in_dead.yaml) reads <prefix>.dead back into kafka_dead. STAGES: (1) domains -- the domain, the employees model (--up-to-partitions 2: departments 1 partition, employees 2) and the xs seed to departments and employees, varied; (2) actions, tagged live -- `produce` in the background: 4 varied passes 15s apart, running while (3) the collections are created and (4) the publishers registered; (5) actions -- wait for produce, then scripts/verify_kafka.py, tagged check: every message sent arrives exactly once, in its table or as a dead letter, at least one was refused (--require-dead), and kafka_unrouted holds nothing (polling, at most 20m); (6) monitor. Run: `tdd xp one-shot --suite kafka/kafka_schema_changes --keep`.
